1. Lifestyle questions & answers

  1. Where would you feel at home?

    Answer: My own space — A comfortable one-bedroom apartment.

    • Share a place — A room of your own. Shared living space.
    • A small place — A modest apartment with the basics.

    • Room to spread out — A larger apartment or rental home.
    • A standout home — A high-end home with extra space and comforts.
  2. How would you like to get around?

    Answer: A reliable used car — A compact car for everyday trips.

    • Keep it light — Walking, cycling, transit, and occasional rides.
    • A car I own — No loan payment. Include upkeep and a replacement fund.
    • ✓ A reliable used car — A compact car for everyday trips. (selected)
    • A newer car — More comfort and newer features.
    • A premium car — A car that is part of the experience.
  3. What is your food-at-home style?

    Answer: Everyday favorites — Mostly groceries, with some small treats.

    • Simple and planned — Cook at home and make the most of each shop.

    • A little more choice — Good variety and some convenience foods.
    • Food I love — Specialty ingredients and more convenience.
    • No skimping — Premium ingredients and a well-stocked kitchen.
  4. How many dinners out would you like each week?

    Answer: 1 dinner a week — A casual meal out to look forward to.

    • Occasional dinners — Less than 1 dinner out a week.
    • ✓ 1 dinner a week — A casual meal out to look forward to. (selected)
    • 2–3 dinners a week — Regular casual meals, with a special dinner sometimes.
    • 4–5 dinners a week — Dinner out is a big part of the week.
    • 6–7 dinners a week — Most evenings out, including memorable dining.
  5. What kind of travel would you like?

    Answer: A simple getaway — Save up for a modest trip.

    • Close to home — Local adventures and day trips.
    • ✓ A simple getaway — Save up for a modest trip. (selected)
    • An annual escape — A proper trip, with room to enjoy it.
    • A few adventures — Longer trips and weekend escapes.
    • Travel in style — Several big trips with extra comfort.
  6. What entertainment would you enjoy?

    Answer: A few nights out — Movies or a small show now and then.

    • Keep it simple — Free events, streaming, and nights with friends.
    • ✓ A few nights out — Movies or a small show now and then. (selected)
    • Regular plans — Movies, music, and shows through the month.
    • A full calendar — More concerts, tickets, and nights out.
    • Make it special — Premium seats and big entertainment experiences.
  7. How would you spend time on hobbies and recreation?

    Answer: A few favorites — A simple hobby or fitness routine.

    • Outdoors and free — Parks, walks, and low-cost hobbies.

    • Go deeper — More lessons, equipment, and active weekends.
    • Big hobbies — Premium clubs, equipment, and recreation.
  8. What feels like your personal style?

    Answer: Everyday basics — Affordable favorites and occasional replacements.

    • Thrift and reuse — Find good pieces and make them last.

    • Style is a priority — Better brands and more frequent updates.

  9. How much room would you like for future goals?

    Answer: Keep it steady — Put something aside each month.

    • Start a cushion — Build a small emergency fund.

4. Profession follow-ups & answers

  1. Which parts of health and helping draw you in?

    Answer: Investigate symptoms and explain possible treatment

    • ✓ Investigate symptoms and explain possible treatment (selected)
    • Care for people and notice changes in how they feel
    • Learn precise hands-on care for teeth and gums
    • Help someone move, communicate or manage daily life
    • Help people with emotions, relationships or practical support
  2. What would you enjoy understanding more deeply?

    Answer: How symptoms, medical history and tests fit together

    • ✓ How symptoms, medical history and tests fit together (selected)
    • How oral health affects someone’s comfort and health
    • How images and medical equipment help care teams
    • How medicines, nutrition or food affect health
    • Why health or social patterns differ across communities
  3. How would you like to help someone?

    Answer: Listen to their concerns and explain a care plan

    • ✓ Listen to their concerns and explain a care plan (selected)
    • Provide practical help and comfort during the day
    • Coach them through recovery or a skill they are building
    • Work through emotional challenges or connect them with support
    • Help them use treatment, medicine or nutrition safely
  4. Which health-care routines would you like to learn?

    Answer: Use evidence, keep records and review complex decisions

    • ✓ Use evidence, keep records and review complex decisions (selected)
    • Carry out careful procedures while helping a patient feel at ease
    • Position people and use equipment to get clear information
    • Track small changes and adapt support over several meetings
    • Collect information and look for ways to improve health in a community
  5. Which problem would you want to understand in more detail?

    Answer: An illness that could have several causes

    • ✓ An illness that could have several causes (selected)
    • A problem with teeth, gums, or a patient’s oral health
    • How movement, speech, or breathing can improve
    • How emotions and life circumstances affect wellbeing
    • How a test, medicine, or prevention programme can help
  6. Which responsibility would you enjoy learning about?

    Answer: Diagnose a medical problem and manage treatment over time

    • ✓ Diagnose a medical problem and manage treatment over time (selected)
    • Provide ongoing nursing care and notice changes
    • Plan and carry out precise dental treatment
    • Guide therapy, rehabilitation, or personal support
    • Produce reliable health information or treatment support
  7. What would you like to explain to someone?

    Answer: Why symptoms point toward a diagnosis and what comes next

    • ✓ Why symptoms point toward a diagnosis and what comes next (selected)
    • How daily care helps someone stay comfortable and recover
    • How to care for teeth and what a dental procedure involves
    • How a medicine, test result, or nutrition change is used
    • How to build a skill or handle a difficult situation
  8. Which supervised experience would you most want to try?

    Answer: Observe a medical consultation and discuss the reasoning afterward

    • ✓ Observe a medical consultation and discuss the reasoning afterward (selected)
    • Observe a dental clinic and its careful procedures
    • See how a nursing or daily-care team supports patients
    • Visit a therapy, counselling, or rehabilitation service
    • Visit a diagnostic lab, pharmacy, or public-health project
  9. Which responsibility would you most want to learn about?

    Answer: Investigate a broad medical problem and plan treatment as a physician.

    • ✓ Investigate a broad medical problem and plan treatment as a physician. (selected)
    • Assess and treat patients through advanced nursing practice.

    • Monitor patients and coordinate their day-to-day nursing care.
    • Diagnose oral disease and plan restorative dental treatment.
    • Clean teeth, assess gum health, and teach preventive oral care.

  10. Which professional would you like to follow for a day?

    Answer: Follow a physician evaluating a complex new patient.

    • ✓ Follow a physician evaluating a complex new patient. (selected)

    • Watch a dentist diagnose a problem and restore a tooth.

    • Watch an assistant prepare the room and support a dental procedure.
